messages:
maria: Quick async standup — audits / KMS sweep.
What I did: ran a dry-run rotation for keyvault-prod key ring, validated new key versions generated and tested decryption path for the staging service. Found one service account (svc-analytics-prod) missing CryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter binding.
Blockers: need IAM owner sign-off to add binding in prod (@jon can you approve adding svc-analytics-prod to key ring IAM?). Also noticed a failing audit query for stale grants — seems like a couple old CI bots still have access.
Today: open PR with remediation + rollback-safe role-change, run a short retention-query for KMS audit logs, and coordinate a low-risk deploy window with infra.

jon: I can approve the binding after a quick review, pinged infra to verify no scheduled maintenance. Please drop the PR link here. :+1:

maria: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3421 — includes terraform change and a small migration to remove stale CI principals. Also added a smoke test in ci/kms-smoke.sh.

sahil: skimmed the PR, left one nit about using for_each vs count in terraform. I can push the change or you can. Also ran the audit query locally and found 2 entries older than 90d for svc-ci-old. We should revoke those.

olivia: flagged a compliance question — retention for KMS logs is 5 years in policy for some regions, legal asked about exceptions for analytics. I'll circle back but for now keep standard retention. See policy: https://confluence.redwood.ai/compliance/log-retention

maria: noted @olivia — will keep to standard retention unless legal approves. Also posting the audit query I used:
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key_ring" AND protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy"' --limit 50 --project=redwood-prod
```

maria: and the rotation dry-run command (staging):
```
./scripts/kms-rotate --key-ring keyvault-prod --dry-run --check-integrity 
```

sec-bot: :warning: Security alert queued: dependency-kms-client v1.2.3 -> CVE-2024-2147 (metadata). Ticket #SEC-847 created and linked to this thread.

jon: noted the CVE, allocating time to triage tomorrow morning. If it's a transitive dep we may patch with a minor bump.

sahil: re: role change — I pushed the terraform nitfix to the PR branch and added a short plan output in the PR description. Also added a canary rollout script to reduce blast radius.

maria: thanks — ACTIONS: @jon review & approve PR, @olivia confirm retention policy by EOD, @sahil coordinate canary deploy, @maria will schedule deploy window and run smoke tests.

jon: will review in next hour. :eyes:

olivia: on it, will check with legal and update here.

maria: cheers, that's all from me for now. ping if you need me during the deploy window.
